text: FreshRSS on a cheap VPS serves the morning news feed and the Hacker News front page to my Fiery reader app.
CMIP6 coordinates dozens of climate models worldwide through a shared experimental protocol to support IPCC assessments.
Adopted the improves-on relation between ADRs when the change is additive rather than contradictory; the older doc keeps status accepted and grows a successor link.
The Parquet Bloom filter page was enabled for point-lookup columns; false-positive rate stayed under 1 percent at 10 bits per key.
Netflix's top nav keeps being the first thing to open on the LG C2, so Kodi lives one Harmony button deep because the Night-In activity maps the orange button to Kodi directly.
New Relic One absorbed the mobile-plus-backend RUM story; distributed tracing across the Swift app and the Node origin landed without a custom SDK bridge.
VictoriaLogs was added next to VictoriaMetrics for the log pipeline; the LogsQL language shared the label model and avoided a second operational skill tree.
requirements.in is the source file and pip-compile writes requirements.txt with --generate-hashes; every transitive dep lands with a sha256, making reruns deterministic on any machine.
Ark UI powers the framework-agnostic primitives behind the Vue 3 admin and the React marketing site; one state machine per component means both apps get identical keyboard semantics.
OpenRA now launches from a single Bottles prefix on the Linux workstation so the Red Alert 2 nights with Omar feel native.

The Furbo bark-alert fires a webhook into Home Assistant which in turn dims the Hue lights in Arlo's crate room because the low-light state calms the reactivity episodes faster than the squirt-bottle routine ever did.
The week-by-week Screen Time report sits in the Sunday journal entry; average, top app, pickups, longest session — four numbers, nothing more.
Wrote the first real career narrative document in February; five years mapped out with three decision points if the industry shifts.
A Home Assistant automation dims the Philips Hue strip behind the turntable whenever the Denon DP-300F starts spinning, which marks the Friday ritual with Amaya.
SPIFFE Workload API is wired into the sidecar injector; short-lived SVIDs arrive on a Unix socket and never touch disk.
Yjs powered the shared document editor; the CRDT merge kept concurrent edits conflict-free without a central ordering server.
AnyList grocery list now auto-generates from Mealie recipe tags since Rowan hates adding staples by hand.
The couple's weekly check-in runs Sunday 20:00 over tea; three prompts — what went well, what chafed, what we want next week — and a 30-minute cap.
JuiceFS over S3 fronted the ML training data; POSIX semantics on top of object storage let PyTorch DataLoader workers mmap files cleanly.
Mom's Aloe Care Smart Hub in the Pensacola condo runs the fall detection through the ceiling-mounted radar sensor instead of a watch because she refuses to wear anything on her wrist.
The Neo4j Graph Data Science library ran PageRank nightly on the citation graph; Louvain communities fed the recommendation bucketing.
Tokio runtime is configured as a multi-threaded scheduler with 8 workers; the websocket gateway pins the network task to a LocalSet so the !Send handle stays on one thread.
USE metrics for the worker pool — Utilisation, Saturation, Errors — emit from the runtime hooks; queue depth and reject count are gauges scraped every fifteen seconds.
Ambient mesh waypoint proxies handled L7 policies only for the namespaces that opted in; the L4-only path stayed cheap on the noisy log shippers.
Secret comparisons use hmac.compare_digest everywhere; the old == check on the webhook signature path briefly leaked a character-at-a-time timing signal in benchmarks.
The themed supper-club pricing model is £22 per head for ingredients, cash or bank transfer; surplus rolls to the next month's budget, never pocketed.
Polly pipelines on the .NET checkout client stack a timeout, retry, and circuit breaker policy in that order; the outer cancellation token aborts everything cleanly under load.
The Songkick concert calendar merged into the Google Calendar via IFTTT on 2026-03-05 so the 'Gigs' subcalendar shows alongside the work schedule without flipping apps.
Outbox relay runs as a sidecar that tails the outbox table via logical replication; the relay pushes to Kafka and marks rows delivered in a second tx, giving at-least-once without dual-write hazards.
Syft generates SPDX and CycloneDX SBOMs per image build; the attestation gets stored next to the image in the OCI registry.
Apache Flink ran the windowed sessionization over the click stream; event-time watermarks plus a 30-minute gap closed sessions cleanly across late-arriving mobile events.
The household cash-buffer floor in the Amex Savings checking is £2,500; any balance above that on the 25th sweeps to the Wealthfront Cash high-yield tier automatically.
Risk-tier labels on PRs drive the review template: low-risk PRs get a lightweight checklist and high-risk PRs require a recorded walkthrough plus two CODEOWNER approvals.
The Hyper Island Digital Data Strategist diploma in Stockholm runs 2026-08-24 through 2027-06-11; nine months, project-based, no written exams.
Hallucination guardrail for library calls: the agent must produce a doc-link tool call resolving the symbol before generating any new import; missing docs means refuse-and-ask.
Required checks list is now codified in a CODEOWNERS-adjacent yaml instead of being clicked into the repo settings by hand.
The bedtime story rule: two picture books for Maya, then one chapter from the Narnia omnibus for Leo, lights out by 8:15pm.
Atlassian's design system is cited in the confluence-plugin package; the link button variants and the focus-ring treatment match Atlassian's tokens so the plugin feels native inside the host app.
Langfuse traces every LLM call from the chat app; span-level cost and latency fed the autoscaler's backpressure signal.
The Acapella iOS app multitracks David's barbershop quartet into the shared iCloud folder so the weekend mixdown in Logic Pro takes ten minutes.
Cassandra wide-row design moved from a single clustering key to a composite with a bucketed time prefix; tombstone scans on deletes fell inside safe thresholds again.
An AirTag clipped inside the backpack of my kindergartener Oliver pings the living-room HomePod mini whenever the bag goes missing between the mudroom and the breakfast table.
Each PR gets a preview URL via Vercel; the bot comments with the link once the build is green.
The daycare rota splits the week: Monday and Wednesday at Little Acorns, Tuesday and Thursday with Nana, Friday home with me.
Ruby services wire the ldclient-rb SDK via Rails initializers; each environment uses a distinct SDK key stored in Rails credentials so a dev machine can never hit prod flags.
Apache Spark batch jobs migrated to Spark on Kubernetes; Yunikorn scheduling kept the mixed streaming and batch fleet fair.
Khan Academy progress for my cousin goes into a shared Airtable so grandma can see the calculus streak from Lisbon.
KServe on Kubernetes exposes the batch scoring jobs via InferenceService CRDs; canary rollout moved to traffic-percentage splits.
Home Assistant pulls real-time Emporia Vue readings and shuts off the dryer when solar drops below 2 kW.
Triton Inference Server backs the multi-model gateway; its ensemble scheduler pipelines a reranker behind the generator.
The anniversary-of-loss candle on 2026-11-14 is already planned: St Luke's hospice chapel at 11:00, then a walk to the pier with Dad's thermos.
Running the annual Newton Rec basketball league now uses TeamSnap alongside a tiny Python script that syncs the court permits from the Parks Dept spreadsheet.
Rill Data served the real-time exploration dashboards; DuckDB-backed local slicing kept the CEO's live revenue view under 200 ms.
The expense-splitting setup with Maya uses Splitwise for day-to-day and a single monthly settle-up to the joint Chase account; receipts photographed into the app.
Helm charts drove the application layer under Argo CD; the values.yaml per environment kept the render deterministic across the four clusters.
Caddy handles autocert for the public dashboards; DNS-01 via Cloudflare avoids exposing port 80 on the bastion.
Services take a settings object at construction so tests can inject an in-memory variant without monkey-patching.
Great Expectations suites gate merges on the core fact tables; expectation failures block the downstream dbt run instead of poisoning marts.
Pokemon ROM hacks live in a separate EmulationStation collection so our nine-year-old Hiro only sees the age-appropriate builds.
Flyte powered the ML training DAGs on the data platform; strongly typed task signatures plus container caching beat what Airflow KubernetesPodOperator gave us.
Confluent Schema Registry governed Avro schema evolution; backward-compatible adds and forward-compatible removes were enforced at publish time, not decode.
Streaming SSE responses wrap events in a sealed envelope with type and seq; that lets reconnect-with-Last-Event-Id replay from the exact gap.
The long commute to Lombard used to feel like lost time until I started treating the 45 minutes as dedicated audiobook space; now it is the best part of the day.
Proxmox VE ran LXC containers alongside KVM guests on the same node; the /etc/pve/lxc configs stayed next to the qemu-server configs without clash.
The morning ritual starts at 05:40 with a glass of water, ten minutes of mobility, and the espresso pulled before any screen.
SDK publishing pipeline enforces semantic version rules through a golden-diff check against the prior minor; a breaking change fails the release job.
Sensors and triggers split in Airflow let the triggerer process hold 5000 idle waits in one Python process; deferrable operators dropped the worker slot pin.
MLIR dialects carried the tensor IR from the frontend down to the vendor backend; the old monolithic IR was split into three dialects for clarity.
CareZone holds the medication list and pharmacy barcodes for mom's eight prescriptions while Google Calendar handles the appointment-reminder SMS to aunt Lila who still refuses any app download.
Every Friday evening is phone-off time; we play board games with the kids until nine.

The Everplans vault holds dad's durable power of attorney PDF, the living will, and the HIPAA release so that Marcus in Seattle can share the documents with the Cleveland Clinic intake desk in under five minutes.
Moved the family photo pipeline off Google Photos onto Immich running on the basement NAS because the shared albums with my kids Wren and Kit now survive any subscription dispute with Google.
All internal HTTPS traffic terminates at Istio's ingress gateway; sidecar proxies handle east-west mTLS.
The Outback's boot organiser has three labelled boxes: Car-Camp, Dog, and Tools; this stops the CB500F kit migrating into the car on race weekends.
The billing service consumes Kafka events, aggregates per tenant in ClickHouse, and exports invoices nightly.
The multi-step form now wraps each step in a fieldset with a legend and announces step changes via an aria-live=polite region; VoiceOver reads the new heading on navigation.
The attention-reset protocol from the February retreat: 20 minutes of silent sit, walk the lane, then open the laptop; replaces the phone-first morning.
Gelato on Shopify printed the custom tote design for Rosa Alvarez's Etsy shop on-demand because the Etsy-native POD rate was eating thirty percent of her margin on the small batch.
Undo/redo on the editor uses a command pattern stack: each mutation pushes a do/undo pair and the store exposes undo() and redo() as plain actions; time travel just walks the stack.
The morning meditation app rotates: Insight Timer Monday and Wednesday, Plum Village Tuesday and Thursday, no app on Friday — silence with a kitchen timer.
The garage organising plan uses four zones: car bay, bike rack on the north wall, tool pegboard on the east, and winter-tyre rack above the freezer.
Lunch Money categorises Priyanka's freelance invoices so the household tax spreadsheet for 2026 stays clean.
Aftership's iOS widget shows the Shopify merchant hop before Amazon's Logistics truck even scans, so the dashboard order status moves from label-created to out-for-delivery in one glance.
The Large Hadron Collider, commissioned at CERN near Geneva in 2008, is a 27-kilometre superconducting proton-proton ring that replaced the LEP electron-positron collider in the same tunnel.
Ramadan 2026 began 2026-02-18; breaking fast at Masjid Al-Noor with the community iftar on Fridays, other nights at home with dates and water first.
The chat thread for the hiking crew of seven uses three reactions only — boot for in, mountain for maybe, sleeping bag for out — voted in on 2026-01-19.
Negative TTLs on Memcached used the add-with-expiration semantic to dampen origin retries; a 1-second negative cache held off the retry storm without poisoning the next legitimate fetch.
The standing dinner-party seating plan at 14 Pennant Mews puts Priya at my right and Dev across from Osman so the architecture talk never stalls.
Knapsack hosts the public documentation site for the shared design system; each MDX page embeds a live Storybook iframe, so API docs and interactive demos stay in the same URL.
User-supplied content passes through DOMPurify after locale-specific formatting; the chain runs format first then sanitise so bidi overrides inside user text cannot break surrounding RTL layout.
The CERN Large Hadron Collider is an underground synchrotron spanning 27 kilometres of superconducting magnets across the Franco-Swiss border.
The charitable giving rule is 5% of gross income, bunched every other year into the DAF; off-years keep only the church tithe and the local school appeal.
Every ADR starts in status proposed; it only flips to accepted after the PR hits approval plus a 48-hour silent window on the team channel.
Ported the nested-boolean toast state to an XState machine with idle, visible, and dismissing states; the transient dismissing state holds focus for the CSS exit animation.
ArgoCD ApplicationSet with the git generator keeps one Application per tenant folder; adding a tenant is now a single directory commit.
MessagePack carried the mobile client payloads; type-tagged binary kept schemaless flexibility while halving the JSON byte count.
The boto3 session in the job runner assumes a least-privilege role per tenant; the base credentials can only call sts:AssumeRole and nothing else.
The walking meditation loop in Stanpit Park is 1.4 km on the gravel side; counting steps in tens, hands behind the back, gaze a metre ahead.
Documented the SDK stability tiers: stable, preview and experimental; experimental classes live under a _preview subpackage and can break between minor versions.
Monorepo uses pnpm workspaces, Turborepo for caching, and changesets for versioning internal packages.
Tested code snippets in Python docs run through doctest in CI; every fenced ```python``` block that imports our SDK is extracted and executed on a matrix of versions.
The backdoor Roth conversion routine happens every January: contribute $7,000 to the Traditional IRA at Schwab, convert two business days later, zero pro-rata thanks to no pre-tax balance.
The 21:00 reading hour in the armchair is sacred: no phone, paperback only, a chamomile tea, lights dimmed to the warm setting.
Templater handles the daily-notes boilerplate that Obsidian's core Templates plugin couldn't because Templater's JavaScript hooks run the weather fetch and the calendar pull at note-open time.
Saturdays for amateur radio revolve around GQRX on a HackRF One tuned to the 40-metre band from the garage.
Prometheus remote_write into Mimir gave us multi-tenant long-term metrics; the tradeoff was a hefty ingester fleet.
Covering indexes with INCLUDE columns let the dashboard query go index-only on Postgres 15; the heap fetch count in EXPLAIN fell to zero once VACUUM caught up.
The notifications slice is normalised by id with an ids array and a byId map; the old nested array had been forcing O(n) updates whenever one toast flipped its read flag.
Airflow orchestrates a nightly dbt run that materialises marts in BigQuery.
The Friday afternoon energy slump is handled with a 20-minute walk around Beaulieu Gardens at 15:00; always the same loop, always alone.
Dynatrace OneAgent was installed on the 400-host legacy estate; auto-discovery of Oracle and IBM MQ dependencies beat the manual Prometheus exporter slog.
Clara and I do a yearly relationship audit every 2026-09-14 anniversary: three things that worked, two that did not, one thing to try — all written before we compare notes.
Kept the Instagram account in read-only mode: signed out of the app, kept the web login, muted every story, unfollowed all brand accounts.
The family calendar in Google Calendar feeds the Echo Show 8 in the hallway so the morning routine announces piano practice for Aiko before the school bus pickup.
Saturday mornings start with a 6am swim at the community pool before the kids are up.
Runbooks live under docs/runbooks/ with a fixed schema: symptom, scope, diagnosis, mitigation, follow-up; on-call templates scaffold a new one in under a minute.
The BVH rebuild was offloaded to a compute queue with async parallel to the gbuffer pass; fit-to-refit heuristic kept the rebuild budget under 0.6 ms a frame.
Cold-start warmups were scheduled via CloudWatch Events; a keep-alive ping every four minutes held the container provisioned under AWS heuristics.
The Glowforge Pro and a Cricut Maker 3 share the makerspace bench but the laser handles the 2026-04-12 birthday-card inserts because the Cricut blade tears the cotton paper at the curves.
The renters-versus-owners math said rent in year one, buy by year three; saving £620 a month toward the deposit rather than paying it down as principal.
Delta snapshots over the wire use a bitmask per component indicating changed fields; the full-snapshot path survives only as the cold join-in-progress fallback for new peers.
Unpackerr replaced the manual post-download extraction glue because the RARBG-style nested archive from the old German release-group feed was otherwise blocking Sonarr imports for hours.
Helicone proxies the OpenAI traffic for log capture; per-user cost attribution fell out of the session header it injects.
Bayesian brain accounts generalise predictive coding by modelling perception as posterior inference over causes of sensory input.
Probabilistic early expiration via the XFetch algorithm refreshed hot keys before TTL; the cache never went cold for the top 1 percent of products under load.
The Petcube Play 2 laser toy feeds Clover's daily activity minutes into the Cattime weight-trend chart because Petcube's webhook posts a play-session JSON that Cattime's ingest accepts unmodified.
The bedding plant rotation runs tulips in the front borders from October planting to April flowering, then dahlia tubers in May.
Laptop dotfiles, shell config, and personal Python utilities all live in one repo managed by chezmoi.
PyPI mirror via devpi on a homelab box fed the restricted-network CI runners; wheel caches rebuild nightly from the upstream simple index.
Inception review happens before the ADR is drafted; the design review happens before implementation starts — the two checkpoints never collapse into one meeting.
A Tasmota-flashed Sonoff plug measures the espresso machine warm-up and posts to MQTT for the kitchen dashboard.
The Stream Deck on the studio desk has a dedicated page for Amelie's game-night intros so OBS scene swaps happen with one tap.
SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH threaded through the Debian, Nix, and npm package outputs; diffoscope stopped flagging timestamp-only variance across identical-input rebuilds.
SBOM generation runs Syft on every release artefact; the CycloneDX JSON gets attached to the GitHub release and signed alongside the binary.
Hedge requests on the read path fire a duplicate after p99 latency elapses; the first response wins and the loser is cancelled via grpc.WithCancel to avoid wasted work.
Experimentation flags go through PostHog feature flags because they integrate directly with the analytics events; plain toggles stay on ConfigCat where experiment metadata would be noise.
Fulcio keyless signing issues per-build ephemeral certs bound to OIDC identities; Rekor logs make rollbacks auditable.
Idris elaborator reflection generated the JSON codec at type-check time; the library shipped without a separate derivation macro.

Medisafe's measurements feature tracked mom's systolic blood pressure off the Omron 7 Series cuff for six months, and the trend line caught the slow creep that the PCP missed in quarterly office readings.
Holiday gift tradition with Sam: one experience, one handmade, no shop-bought; started in 2021.
The Polar H10 GPX export fed a bike-rental route into Komoot for the Mallorca training week because Komoot's turn-by-turn on the Garmin beat the Polar watch's barebones prompts.
Poll-worker shifts for the 2026-04-07 municipal primary sit in a shared Google Calendar with each precinct colour-coded and the check-in times pinned.
JUnit 4 to JUnit 5 happened incrementally thanks to the vintage engine; we turned it off a year later once the last @RunWith was gone.
Cross-tab sync for the user preferences store uses the BroadcastChannel API; any setting change rebroadcasts and peer tabs merge via a last-write-wins timestamp.
The backend follows a ports-and-adapters layout: services call repositories, which wrap database drivers.
The vault lives in a git repo on a Hetzner box and pushes every 15 minutes through the Obsidian Git plugin so the 2026-03-20 laptop-drive failure lost exactly zero notes.
AWS CDK in Python built the data-platform VPC and EKS cluster; the L3 constructs bundled IAM and security-group defaults that the raw CloudFormation templates kept getting wrong.
LDAP queries escape the user input with ldap3's escape_filter_chars; the dn path uses escape_rdn so an attacker-controlled username can't break out of the filter.
The Calibre-Web server on the Unraid NAS at 192.168.1.42 streams the shared family library to every device so the nieces can grab the Rick Riordan backlog from their Kobo Clara BWs.
SOPS was wired to AWS KMS for production values; age keys stayed as a break-glass fallback in the offline safe, not as a primary decryption path.
